sourcePatch.name: patches/0051-web-animation-promise-observer.patch
sourcePatch.appliedBy: root to C:/wk/src (v2: rejections reported when scheduled)

qualifications: Under this host WebCore C++ microtasks (EventLoopTaskGroup::queueMicrotask) never run: DisallowVMEntry refuses the drain. The JS-visible AbortError rejection of ready/finished therefore never happens; only the native observer (patch 0051) reports it, when the engine schedules it. The native outcome is the contract. Root follow-up with the VM-entry investigation.

Completions arrive only from rv_run_loop_cycle (or rv_resource_release/cancel, rv_host_destroy, a new document), while playback and CSS events dispatch inside rv_host_update; probes compare settlement order and event order separately, per animation, plus one cross-animation order (cancel inside a listener).
WebKit sets the hold time of a pending pause from the ready time, Chromium from the pause() call: currentTime after a pending pause (and the reverse that follows) is compared as presence only.
A finished animation holds max(previous current time, end): after a late update its currentTime exceeds the end; replace-scenario currentTime is compared as presence only.
Cancel events (animationcancel, transitioncancel) carry a frame-dependent elapsedTime: presence only. Cross-element event order within one frame differs between engines and is not asserted.
Hand-written exports rv_event_target_add_listener and rv_host_load_html are still const char* in this tree (#145 Utf8 conversion at integration; strscan lists 2 calls in animation_lifecycle.py).
